Filters accept raw pipe-delimited strings or nonempty sequential string lists joined once with |. List items may be empty but must not contain |; null omits and an empty list rejects. Omitted includeAcctTypes includes all account types; omitted skipAcctTypes excludes none. Account types remain server-validated; supply ordinary values without URL pre-encoding. Row fields remain optional.

evidence.note: The pinned optional nonnullable include_acct_types parameter is a concrete string and explicitly describes pipe-separated account types.
